limitations: A .d file proves named dependencies, not their historical bytes. An observed current hash without an object-associated pin or exact parent archive origin/hash remains explicitly unproven.
Current canonical files are inventoried only as observed dependency locations. They are never authorized substitutes for retained accepted source or object bytes.
The accepted parent archive preserves a scoped prior USB overlay/evidence closure, not a complete clean APP or USB rebuild tree.
Role and object-bound variants remain separate. Broad receipt source_pins can include unused files from the other role; only actual .d dependencies select overlays here.
Implicit toolchain runtime/library resolution and original working directories for any relative .d entries are outside the explicit object graph.
No device flash, option bytes, preferences, recording DATs, object payloads or whole build trees are copied into this inventory.
